lines: Downtown Calgary hides a second city, about fifteen feet above the street.
It is called the Plus Fifteen network.
Since the first bridge went up in nineteen sixty-nine, it has grown to eighty-six bridges.
Together they link more than sixteen kilometres of heated, weather-protected walkways.
Bridges over City roads are built by developers in exchange for extra building density, and then owned by The City.
So in a Calgary winter, you can cross much of downtown without stepping outside.
